name: Transport Means 3
definition: Describes the multimodal or the individual transport of goods.

ModeCode.name: Mode Code
ModeCode.definition: Code specifying the transport mode for the delivery of the consignment, such as by air, sea, rail, road or inland waterway. Reference UN/ECE Recommendation 19 - Code for Modes of Transport (www.unece.org/cefact/recommendations).

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique identification of the means of transport, such as the International Maritime Organization number of a vessel.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name, expressed as text, of the means of transport.
